content.prompt: Precisely edit this original full-frame painted sleeping copper dragon in matchbox beside warm fireplace shadow. Preserve dragon identity/anatomy/pose and main composition/style. This is one folded part of existing box, no sticker, no detached new object, no grain/specks. Same matte painted cardboard. Return one matching crop.
